Armed man arrested at Trump golf course before fundraiser

Authorities arrested a man carrying ammunition at the Trump National Golf Course in Rancho Palos Verdes, California, on Sunday. The arrest occurred as former President Donald Trump was preparing to arrive for a Republican National Committee fundraising dinner. Police found a loaded pistol and rifle in the suspect's car and home. The man, identified as Jeanine John Taele, was allegedly photographing security preparations and monitoring security at the course days before Trump's visit. The Los Angeles County Sheriff's Department announced the arrest.
